mission.display_title: Name response and explanatory variables with intent
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to make response vs explanatory naming a deliberate modelling move — so you enter linear regression with a clear outcome variable and predictors, without pretending the whole of 4.1 is finished.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force the candidate to discriminate response from explanatory variables on an actuarial data sketch and refuse treating 'all columns are predictors' as modelling.
mission.educational_intent: Produce a cognitive move from data table familiarity to lawful response/explanatory roles.
mission.learning_objective: Identify and justify response and explanatory variables for a linear regression modelling task.
mission.concept_focus: Data sketch → name Y → name X's → refuse column-soup modelling.
mission.prior_bridge: Trust Front opens at classical linear models (4.1). No Continuity Front handoff from Gamma — this is mid-spine entry.
mission.why_now: 4.1.1 is the lawful first Learning day of CS1-003; without it, least squares and software fit have no roles.
mission.expected_benefit: Study Progress for variable roles — not Topic Complete for 4.1.2–4.1.5.
mission.explainability: Assigned as Campaign Delta Day 1 because EP-001 Wave 2 commissions Trust Front at 4.1.1.
success_criteria: Closed-book, name one response and at least one explanatory variable for a stated scenario.
Justify each role in one sentence.
Refuse one 'every column is a predictor' claim.
task_descriptions: Sketch Y and X roles before opening the CMP.
Complete Guided Reading through CMP Syllabus 4.1.1.
Closed-book Knowledge Checks: roles + refuse column-soup.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.1.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. For a portfolio: claim frequency as Y, age and territory as X. (1) Which is response? (2) Which are explanatory? (3) One-sentence justification each.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Response = claim frequency (Y). Explanatory = age, territory (X). Justification: we model frequency as the outcome explained by rating factors.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.1.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. A colleague dumps 40 columns into a regression 'as predictors'. Refuse in one sentence and restate how you choose response vs explanatory first.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse: column-soup is not modelling. First name the response (what you predict/explain), then choose explanatory variables with a modelling warrant.
